title: Dabbaaldegyo iyo saaxiibo
description: Ten short, simple stories about birthdays, parties and friends: a little girl's eighth birthday, a grandfather's eightieth, two friends at the river in August, a blouse for a friend's wedding, New Year fireworks in Toronto, a cookout in the hills, a sick friend's soup, an interpreter at a birthday in Stockholm, a party hall in Mogadishu and a birthday letter from London.

lessons.title: Hoodo waa sideed jir
lessons.summary: Little Hoodo in Garoowe turns eight in February; her big sister Mulki buys apples, bananas, guavas, a coconut, a big bag of sweets and bottles of milk for a small party, and their little brother Cige eats too many sweets and is sick.
lessons.text:
Hoodo waa gabadh yar oo ku nool Garoowe. Hoodo waxay leedahay walaal weyn oo la yidhaahdo Mulki iyo walaal yar oo la yidhaahdo Cige. Hoodo iyo Cige waxay Mulki ku yidhaahdaan "abaayo".

Bisha febraayo, Hoodo waxay noqon doontaa sideed jir. "Abaayo, bisha febraayo waxaan noqon doonaa sideed jir," ayay tidhi Hoodo. "Kulan yar ma ii samayn kartaa?"

"Haa," ayay tidhi Mulki. "Febraayo kulan yar baynu samayn doonnaa. Saaxiibbadaa way iman karaan."

Maalintii kulanka, Mulki iyo Hoodo waxay tageen suuqa. Waxay iibsadeen tufaax, muus, saytuun iyo qumbe. Tufaaxu waa guduud yahay. Muusku waa macaan yahay. Saytuunka Hoodo aad bay u jeceshahay. Mulki waxay sidoo kale iibsatay kiish weyn oo nacnac ah iyo lix quraaradood oo caano ah.

"Abaayo, kiishadu waa weyn tahay!" ayay tidhi Hoodo.

"Haa," ayay tidhi Mulki. "Laakiin nacnac badan waa xun yahay."

Galabtii, saaxiibbada Hoodo way yimaadeen. Carruurtu way ciyaareen, way qosleen. Kadib waxay cuneen tufaaxa, muuska iyo saytuunka. Mulki waxay mindi ku jartay qumbaha. Qumbaha gudihiisa biyo cad ayaa ku jira. Carruurtu way cabbeen biyaha qumbaha.

Cige wuxuu qaatay kiishada nacnaca. Nacnac badan ayuu cunay. "Cige, nacnac badan ha cunin," ayay tidhi Mulki. Laakiin Cige wuu sii cunay. Kiishadii nacnaca way yaraatay.

Wax yar kadib, Cige calool xanuun baa qabtay. Kadib wuu matagay. Hoodo iyo saaxiibbadeed way eegeen. Mulki waxay keentay quraarad biyo ah. Cige biyaha quraaradda ku jiray wuu cabbay. Hadda wuu fiican yahay.

"Abaayo, waan matagay, waayo nacnac badan baan cunay," ayuu yidhi Cige. "Maanta nacnac kale ma cuni doono. Tufaax iyo muus ayaan cuni doonaa."

Mulki way qososhay. Hoodo sidoo kale way qososhay. "Mahadsanid, abaayo," ayay tidhi Hoodo. "Sideed jir waa da' fiican!"

Su'aalo:
Hoodo goorma ayay sideed jir noqon doontaa?
Hoodo waxay sideed jir noqon doontaa bisha febraayo.
Mulki maxay suuqa ka iibsatay?
Mulki waxay iibsatay tufaax, muus, saytuun, qumbe, kiish nacnac ah iyo quraarado caano ah.
Yaa qumbaha mindi ku jaray?
Mulki ayaa qumbaha mindi ku jartay.
Cige muxuu cunay?
Cige wuxuu cunay nacnac badan.
Cige muxuu sameeyay kadib?
Cige wuu matagay.
Mulki maxay Cige u keentay?
Mulki waxay Cige u keentay quraarad biyo ah.

lessons.title: Barre waa siddeetan jir
lessons.summary: Blind old Barre in Burco turns eighty; his family and his seventy-year-old sister Nafiso gather round his old chair, the women sing a buraanbur for him, and the eloquent old man tells his granddaughter Siraad about the Dervish state, the socialist years and Somaliness, while tears come to her eyes.
lessons.text:
Barre waa nin weyn oo ku nool Burco. Sannadkan, Barre wuxuu noqonayaa siddeetan jir. Barre waa aabbaha aabbaha Siraad. Siraad waa gabadh laba iyo toban jir ah. Siraad iyo qoyskeedu waxay u yimaadeen guriga Barre, waayo maanta Barre waa siddeetan jir.

Barre waa indhoole. Barre wax ma arko, laakiin wax walba wuu maqlaa. Indhoolahu wuxuu leeyahay dhego aad u fiican. Barre wuxuu ku fadhiyaa kursi gabow ah oo geed hoostiis yaal. "Kursigan gabowga ah waxaan iibsaday markii aan soddon jir ahaa," ayuu yidhi Barre. Kursigu waa gabow, laakiin Barre aad buu u jecel yahay.

Walaashiis Nafiso ayaa ka timid Hargeysa. Nafiso waa toddobaatan jir. "Walaalkay waa siddeetan jir, aniguna waxaan ahay toddobaatan jir," ayay tidhi Nafiso, way qososhay. "Toddobaatan iyo siddeetan, waxaynu nahay laba qof oo weyn!"

Haweenkii qoyska ayaa Barre u qaaday buraanbur. Buraanburku wuxuu ka hadlayay nolosha Barre. Barre wuu dhagaystay. Buraanburka aad buu u jeclaaday.

Kadib Barre ayaa hadlay. Barre waa aftahan. Markuu aftahanku hadlo, qof walba wuu dhagaystaa. "Aabbahay wuxuu ii sheegi jiray sheekooyinka Daraawiish," ayuu yidhi Barre. "Waqti hore, Daraawiish waxay lahaayeen dowlad la yidhaahdo qusuusi. Qusuusigu wuxuu ahaa dowladdii Daraawiish."

"Markii aan dhallinyaro ahaa, waxaa jirtay dowladdii hantiwadaagga," ayuu yidhi Barre. "Waqtigii hantiwadaagga, dugsi baan ka shaqeeyay. Carruurta waxaan baray qoraalka afka Soomaaliga."

"Wax badan way is beddelaan," ayuu yidhi aftahanku. "Laakiin soomaalinimadu waa sidii hore. Soomaalinimadu waa afkeenna iyo dhaqankeenna. Carruurtu ha bartaan soomaalinimada."

Siraad way faraxsanayd, laakiin illin baa ka timid indhaha. Nafiso sidoo kale illin baa ka timid indhaha. Nafiso illinteeda way tirtirtay. Siraad illinteeda way tirtirtay.

"Siddeetan sannadood oo kale ku noolow!" ayay tidhi Siraad. Barre wuu qoslay.

Su'aalo:
Barre ma noqonayaa toddobaatan jir mise siddeetan jir?
Barre wuxuu noqonayaa siddeetan jir.
Barre ma wax arkaa?
Maya, Barre wax ma arko, waayo waa indhoole.
Nafiso ma siddeetan jir baa?
Maya, Nafiso waa toddobaatan jir.
Haweenku maxay Barre u qaadeen?
Haweenku waxay Barre u qaadeen buraanbur.
Qusuusigu muxuu ahaa?
Qusuusigu wuxuu ahaa dowladdii Daraawiish.
Barre xaggee buu ka shaqeeyay waqtigii hantiwadaagga?
Waqtigii hantiwadaagga, Barre wuxuu ka shaqeeyay dugsi.

lessons.title: Kaabadda Afgooye
lessons.summary: On a hot August day Haybe turns fifteen and goes with his friend Qaasim to the bridge over the Shabeelle at Afgooye; both are thirsty, Haybe wades through the river and spits out the muddy water, a turtle swims past, a bee stings Qaasim and a thorn sticks in Haybe's thumb.
lessons.text:
Haybe iyo Qaasim waa laba saaxiib oo ku nool Afgooye. Maanta waa maalintii Haybe dhashay. Haybe wuxuu noqday shan iyo toban jir. Agoosto waa bil kulul. Bisha agoosto, Afgooye aad bay u kulul tahay. Haybe iyo Qaasim waxay rabaan inay tagaan webiga Shabeelle.

Webiga waxaa saaran kaabad weyn. Haybe iyo Qaasim waxay istaageen kaabadda. Kaabadda ayay biyaha ka eegeen. Qorraxda agoosto aad bay u kulul tahay. Haybe harraad baa qabtay. Qaasim sidoo kale harraad baa qabtay. Way harraadeen, laakiin biyo ma sitaan.

Meeshaas, webigu biyo yar buu leeyahay. "Kaalay, aynu webiga ka maaxno," ayuu yidhi Haybe.

"Maya," ayuu yidhi Qaasim. "Kaabadda ayaa ka fiican. Webiga ha ka maaxin."

Haybe wuu maaxday. Biyaha webiga ayuu cabbay, waayo harraad baa qabay. Laakiin biyaha webiga dhoobo ayaa ku jirtay. Haybe biyaha wuu tufay. Mar kale ayuu cabbay, mar kale ayuu tufay. "Biyahan dhoobada leh ha cabbin," ayuu yidhi Qaasim, wuuna qoslay.

Biyaha dhexdooda qubo weyn ayaa ku jirtay. Qubadu waxay lahayd qolof adag. "Qubada eeg!" ayuu yidhi Haybe. Qubadu wax yar ayay socotay, kadib biyaha ayay gashay.

Haybe kaabadda ayuu ku soo noqday. Kaabadda dhinaceeda geed weyn ayaa ku yaal. Geedka waxaa ku jirtay shinni badan. Qaasim wuxuu rabay inuu geedka caleen ka qaado. Shinni ayaa Qaasim gacanta ka qaniintay. "Shinnida ha taaban!" ayuu yidhi Haybe.

Qaasim gacantiisa wuu xaganayaa. "Ha xagan," ayuu yidhi Haybe. "Haddii aad xaganayso, waa kuu xun tahay." Laakiin Qaasim wuu sii xaganayay.

Kadib Haybe wuxuu qaaday ul yar oo qodax leh. Qodaxdu suulka Haybe ayay gashay. "Suulkayga!" ayuu yidhi Haybe. Qaasim wuxuu qodaxda ka saaray suulka Haybe.

Labada saaxiib waxay ku noqdeen guriga. Hooyada Haybe waxay labada saaxiib siisay biyo nadiif ah. "Maanta waa maalin adag," ayay tidhi, way qososhay.

Su'aalo:
Haybe maanta muxuu noqday?
Haybe wuxuu noqday shan iyo toban jir.
Webiga Shabeelle maxaa saaran?
Webiga Shabeelle waxaa saaran kaabad weyn.
Haybe muxuu biyaha webiga u tufay?
Haybe biyaha wuu tufay, waayo dhoobo bay lahaayeen.
Maxaa biyaha dhexdooda ku jiray?
Biyaha dhexdooda qubo weyn ayaa ku jirtay.
Maxaa Qaasim qaniintay?
Shinni ayaa Qaasim qaniintay.
Qodaxdu xaggee bay gashay?
Qodaxdu waxay gashay suulka Haybe.

lessons.title: Shaatiga Ebyan
lessons.summary: Ebyan comes to her maternal aunt Hufan in Kismaayo for her friend Khayra's wedding; she washes her white blouse with soap, dries it in the sun and her aunt irons it, at night her cousin Ruweyda keeps telling her to move over in the small bed, and in the morning both girls brush their teeth.
lessons.text:
Ebyan waa gabadh lix iyo toban jir ah. Berri waa kulanka guurka saaxiibteeda Khayra. Ebyan waxay u timid Kismaayo, guriga habaryarteed Hufan. Habaryar Hufan waxay leedahay gabadh la yidhaahdo Ruweyda.

Ebyan waxay keentay shaati cad oo qurxoon. Laakiin shaatigu waa wasakh. "Habaryar, shaatigaygu waa wasakh," ayay tidhi Ebyan.

"Shaatiga ku dhaq biyo iyo saabuun," ayay tidhi habaryar Hufan. Habaryar waxay Ebyan siisay saabuun cusub. Ebyan waxay shaatiga ku dhaqday biyo iyo saabuun. Saabuuntu waxay ahayd mid cusub. Hadda shaatigu waa nadiif.

"Hadda shaatiga qallaji," ayay tidhi Hufan. Ebyan waxay shaatiga dhigtay qorraxda. Qorraxda Kismaayo way kulul tahay. Qorraxdu waxay shaatiga qallajin doontaa. Hal saacad kadib, shaatigu wuu qalalan yahay.

Kadib habaryar Hufan waxay keentay feero. "Feeradu waa kulul tahay, ha taaban," ayay tidhi. Habaryar waxay shaatiga ku marisay feerada. Hadda shaatigu waa qurxoon yahay. "Mahadsanid, habaryar," ayay tidhi Ebyan.

Habeenkii, Ebyan waxay la seexatay Ruweyda. Sariirta Ruweyda way yar tahay. Habaryar Hufan waxay keentay buste iyo barkin. "Bustahan iyo barkintan qaado," ayay tidhi. Ebyan bustaha iyo barkinta way qaadatay.

Ruweyda ma seexan karin. "Ebyan, durug!" ayay tidhi. "Meel ma haysto." Ebyan way durugtay. Wax yar kadib, Ruweyda waxay tidhi: "Durug mar kale!" Ebyan mar kale way durugtay. Hadda Ebyan waxay joogtaa sariirta afkeeda. Bustaha iyo barkinta dhulka ayay ku dhaceen. Ebyan iyo Ruweyda way qosleen.

Subaxdii, Ebyan waxay tagtay suuliga. Suuliga ayay ilkaha ku cadeysatay. Kadib Ruweyda ayaa suuliga tagtay. Ruweyda sidoo kale way cadeysatay. "Ilkaha way cad yihiin," ayay tidhi Ruweyda.

Ebyan waxay gashay shaatigii cadaa. Kadib Ebyan iyo Ruweyda waxay tageen kulanka guurka Khayra. "Shaatigaagu waa qurxoon yahay," ayay tidhi Khayra.

Su'aalo:
Ebyan xaggee bay u timid?
Ebyan waxay u timid guriga habaryarteed Hufan, Kismaayo.
Ebyan shaatiga maxay ku dhaqday?
Ebyan waxay shaatiga ku dhaqday biyo iyo saabuun.
Yaa shaatiga feerada ku mariyay?
Habaryar Hufan ayaa shaatiga feerada ku marisay.
Maxaa shaatiga qallajin doona?
Qorraxda ayaa shaatiga qallajin doonta.
Ruweyda maxay ku tidhi Ebyan?
Ruweyda waxay tidhi: "Ebyan, durug!"
Ebyan xaggee bay ilkaha ku cadeysatay?
Ebyan waxay ilkaha ku cadeysatay suuliga.

lessons.title: Baaruudda Toronto
lessons.summary: On the last night of December, Kulmiye takes his wife Luul and five-year-old Yaasir to a park in the east of Toronto for the New Year fireworks; the fireworks are delayed by the wind, then light up the sky with a noise like thunder, Yaasir cries and calls for his father, and ash falls on the snow.
lessons.text:
Kulmiye waa nin ku nool Toronto. Xaaskiisa waa Luul. Wiilkooda Yaasir waa shan jir. Habeenka ugu dambeeya ee diseembar, magaaladu waxay samaysaa baaruud. Diseembar kadib, sannad cusub ayaa yimaada.

"Aabbe, baaruud waa maxay?" ayuu weydiiyay Yaasir.

"Baaruuddu waa dab yar oo cirka u kaca," ayuu yidhi Kulmiye. "Baaruuddu waxay ifisaa cirka oo dhan."

Kulmiye, Luul iyo Yaasir waxay tageen beer weyn oo ku taal badhiga magaalada. Badhiga Toronto waxaa jooga dad badan. Hawadu way qabow tahay. Dhulka baraf baa saaran.

Baaruudda waxaa la rabay saacadda laba iyo toban. Laakiin baaruudda waa la daahiyey. Dabayl xoog leh ayaa jirtay. "Maxaa baaruudda loo daahiyey?" ayuu weydiiyay Yaasir. "Dabaysha darteed baa loo daahiyey," ayuu yidhi Kulmiye.

Kulmiye wuxuu tagay inuu shaah kulul soo iibsado. Yaasir wuxuu rabay aabbe. "Hooyo, aabbe u ci!" ayuu yidhi. "Kulmiye!" ayay tidhi Luul. Kulmiye ma maqal. "Hooyo, mar kale u ci!" ayuu yidhi Yaasir. Luul mar kale ayay tidhi: "Kulmiye!" Kulmiye wuu maqlay, wuuna soo noqday.

Kadib, baaruuddii ayaa timid. Iftiin casaan, buluug iyo cagaar ah ayaa cirka ifiyay. Baaruuddu cirka oo dhan bay ifisay. Laakiin codkeedu wuxuu ahaa sida onkod. Onkod oo kale.

Yaasir cabsi buu qabay. Wuu booyay. Booyada Yaasir way weynaatay. "Cabsi ha qabin," ayuu yidhi Kulmiye. "Waa sida onkodka, laakiin onkod ma aha." Kulmiye wiilkiisa ayuu qaaday. Yaasir mar dambe ma booyin.

Gubidda baaruudda ayaa qiiq iyo dambas keentay. Dambas yar oo madow ayaa ku dhacay barafka cad. "Hooyo, barafku wuxuu leeyahay dambas," ayuu yidhi Yaasir. "Waa dambaska baaruudda," ayay tidhi Luul. "Gubidda baaruuddu way qurux badan tahay, laakiin gubidda baaruuddu waxay keentaa dambas."

Gurigii markay ku noqdeen, Yaasir wuu qoslay. "Aabbe, diseembarka dambe mar kale baaruudda aynu aragno!" ayuu yidhi.

Su'aalo:
Kulmiye iyo qoyskiisu xaggee bay tageen?
Waxay tageen beer weyn oo ku taal badhiga Toronto.
Maxaa baaruudda loo daahiyey?
Baaruudda waxaa loo daahiyey dabaysha darteed.
Yaasir muxuu hooyadii ku yidhi?
Yaasir wuxuu yidhi: "Hooyo, aabbe u ci!"
Codka baaruuddu muxuu ahaa?
Codka baaruuddu wuxuu ahaa sida onkod.
Yaasir muxuu sameeyay markuu cabsi qabay?
Yaasir wuu booyay.
Maxaa ku dhacay barafka?
Dambaska baaruudda ayaa ku dhacay barafka.

lessons.title: Hilibka buurta
lessons.summary: For Shire's thirtieth birthday he and his friends Jirde and Calaale push a one-wheeled cart of bricks and meat into the hills near Boorama; they dig a fire pit, a puff adder lies under a brick, a baboon snatches the bag of apples, and Shire stops Calaale from throwing stones at it.
lessons.text:
Shire wuxuu noqday soddon jir. Saaxiibbadiis Jirde iyo Calaale waxay ku yidhaahdeen: "Kaalay, buuraha Boorama aynu tagno. Halkaas hilib iyo bariis baynu ku cuni doonnaa."

Saddexda saaxiib waxay qaateen gaari yar oo hal giraangir leh. Gaariga waxay saareen leben, hilib, biyo iyo kiish tufaax ah. Gaarigu wuxuu leeyahay laba daab. Shire labada daab ayuu qabtay, wuuna socday. Daabka gaariga si adag buu u qabtay.

Jidku waa adag yahay. Giraangirta gaariga ayaa dhagax ku dhegtay. Shire gaariga wuu riixay, laakiin gaarigu ma socon. "Leben badan ayaa ku jira," ayuu yidhi Shire. "Anigu ma riixi karo." Jirde iyo Calaale ayaa yimid. "Haddii aynu wada riixno, waynu riixi karnaa," ayuu yidhi Jirde. Saddexdoodu way wada riixeen, giraangirtuna mar kale way socotay.

Buurta korkeeda, Calaale wuxuu bilaabay qodidda bohol yar oo dabka la dhigo. Qodiddu way adkayd, waayo dhulku dhagax badan buu leeyahay. Jirde ayaa qodidda ka caawiyay.

Shire lebenka ayuu bohosha dhinaceeda dhigay. Markuu leben kale qaaday, abeeso ayaa lebenka hoostiisa ku jirtay. "Abeeso!" ayuu yidhi Shire. Saddexda nin way carareen. Abeesadu wax yar ayay socotay, kadib geedaha ayay gashay. "Abeesadu way tagtay," ayuu yidhi Calaale.

Jirde wuxuu geed yar ka rifay caleemo qalalan. Caleemo badan buu rifay. Kadib caleemo qalalan dab bay ku shideen. Hilibkii way dubteen.

Markay hilibka cunayeen, daanyeer weyn ayaa yimid. Daanyeerku wuxuu dhiftay kiishada tufaaxa. Kiishadii buu dhiftay, kadibna geed buu fuulay.

Calaale wuxuu qaaday dhagax. Calaale tuurista dhagaxa aad buu u yaqaan. "Ha samayn!" ayuu yidhi Shire. "Tuurista dhagaxa waa halis. Daanyeerku wuu ku qaniini karaa." Calaale dhagaxii wuu dhigay.

Daanyeerkii tufaaxii wuu cunay. Shire wuu qoslay. "Tufaaxa ha cuno," ayuu yidhi. "Maanta waa maalin fiican, xitaa daanyeerka."

Su'aalo:
Shire gaariga ma riixi karay?
Maya, Shire gaariga ma riixi karin, waayo leben badan ayaa ku jiray.
Yaa bilaabay qodidda bohosha?
Calaale ayaa bilaabay qodidda bohosha.
Maxaa lebenka hoostiisa ku jiray?
Lebenka hoostiisa abeeso ayaa ku jirtay.
Daanyeerku muxuu dhiftay?
Daanyeerku wuxuu dhiftay kiishada tufaaxa.
Jirde muxuu geedka ka rifay?
Jirde wuxuu geedka ka rifay caleemo qalalan.
Shire muxuu ka yidhi tuurista dhagaxa?
Shire wuxuu yidhi tuurista dhagaxa waa halis.

lessons.title: Maraqa Hani
lessons.summary: Ten-year-old Faa'iso in Hargeysa has a lung illness and cannot go to her friend Hani's birthday party; she is sad, but after the party Hani brings her tomato soup with little salt, bread and butter, and a week later the medicine has healed her lungs.
lessons.text:
Faa'iso waa gabadh toban jir ah oo ku nool Hargeysa. Saaxiibteeda ugu fiican waa Hani. Berri Hani waxay noqonaysaa toban jir, kulan yarna way samaynaysaa.

Laakiin Faa'iso way jiran tahay. Habeenkii si fiican uma neefsan karto. Hooyadeed waxay u kaxaysay isbitaalka. Dhakhtarku wuxuu yidhi: "Neefso." Faa'iso way neefsatay. "Mar kale neefso," ayuu yidhi. Faa'iso mar kale ayay neefsatay.

"Sambabkeeda ayaa xanuun qaba," ayuu yidhi dhakhtarku. "Sambabku wuxuu u baahan yahay daawo. Faa'iso hadda si fiican uma neefsan karto. Bogsiinta sambabku waxay qaadanaysaa toddobaad. Daawadani sambabka way bogsiisaa."

"Berri ma tagi karaa kulanka Hani?" ayay weydiisay Faa'iso.

"Maya. Guriga joog oo naso."

Faa'iso way murugaysan tahay. Maalintii kulanka, Faa'iso waxay ku jirtay sariirteeda. Way murugaysan tahay, waayo kulanka Hani ma joogi karto. "Saaxiibbaday oo dhan kulanka way joogaan. Aniga kaliya ayaa guriga jooga," ayay tidhi.

Galabtii, qof ayaa albaabka garaacay. Waa Hani. "Faa'iso, maraq baan kuu keenay," ayay tidhi Hani. "Hooyaday ayaa samaysay. Waa maraq yaanyo leh."

Maraqa waxaa ku jira yaanyo iyo hilib. Milix yar ayaa ku jirta. "Milix badan ha cunin," ayay tidhi hooyada Faa'iso. "Haa, maraqa milix yar uun baa ku jirta," ayay tidhi Hani.

Hani waxay sidoo kale keentay roodhi iyo subag. Faa'iso roodhiga subag bay ku marisay. Roodhiga iyo maraqa way cuntay. "Maraqa yaanyada leh aad buu u macaan yahay," ayay tidhi. "Roodhiga iyo subagga sidoo kale way macaan yihiin."

Faa'iso hadda murugaysan ma aha. Way faraxsan tahay. "Toddobaad kadib, kulan kale baynu samayn doonnaa," ayay tidhi Hani.

Toddobaad kadib, daawadu way bogsiisay sambabka Faa'iso. Hadda si fiican ayay u neefsan kartaa.

Su'aalo:
Faa'iso ma tagi kartaa kulanka Hani?
Maya, Faa'iso way jiran tahay, sambabkeeda ayaa xanuun qaba.
Dhakhtarku muxuu ku yidhi Faa'iso?
Dhakhtarku wuxuu yidhi: "Neefso."
Faa'iso sidee bay ahayd maalintii kulanka?
Faa'iso way murugaysan tahay, waayo kulanka ma joogi karto.
Hani maxay u keentay Faa'iso?
Hani waxay u keentay maraq yaanyo leh, roodhi iyo subag.
Maraqa milix badan ma ku jirtaa?
Maya, maraqa milix yar uun baa ku jirta.
Maxaa sambabka Faa'iso bogsiiyey?
Daawada ayaa sambabka Faa'iso bogsiisay.

lessons.title: Turjubaanka xariifka ah
lessons.summary: At Basra's thirtieth birthday in Stockholm, her friend Cabdirisaaq, a clever interpreter, translates for her Swedish colleague Astrid; a two-faced guest, Cawaale, praises the food to Basra and runs it down behind her back, which irritates Cabdirisaaq, and Astrid has to choose between tea and Somali coffee.
lessons.text:
Basra waa naag ku nool Stockholm. Maanta Basra waxay noqonaysaa soddon jir. Waxay saaxiibbadeed u samaynaysaa kulan yar oo gurigeeda ah.

Saaxiibteeda shaqada waa Astrid. Astrid Soomaali ma taqaan. Basra waxay sidoo kale u sheegtay saaxiibkeed Cabdirisaaq inuu yimaado. Cabdirisaaq waa turjubaan. Turjubaanku waa qof hadalka af kale u beddela. Dadka qaar waxay yidhaahdaan "turjumaan". Turjubaan iyo turjumaan waa isku mid.

Cabdirisaaq waa nin xariif ah. Wuxuu yaqaan saddex af. Turjunkiisu waa heersare. "Cabdirisaaq waa turjumaanka ugu fiican ee Stockholm," ayay tidhi Basra. "Turjunkiisu marna khalad ma leh."

Kulanka waxaa yimid nin la yidhaahdo Cawaale. Cawaale wuxuu Basra ku yidhi: "Cuntadaadu waa heersare! Waa cuntada ugu fiican Stockholm." Basra way faraxsan tahay.

Laakiin kadib Cawaale wuxuu u tagay nin kale. "Cuntadu waa xun tahay," ayuu yidhi. "Bariiska milix ma leh." Cabdirisaaq hadalkaas wuu maqlay. Cawaale wuxuu xanaajiyay Cabdirisaaq. "Ninkani waa jeesjees," ayuu yidhi Cabdirisaaq. "Basra wuxuu u sheegay in cuntadu heersare tahay, nin kalena wuxuu u sheegay in cuntadu xun tahay."

Cabdirisaaq wuxuu u tagay Cawaale. "Ha noqon nin jeesjees ah," ayuu ku yidhi. Cawaale wax ma odhan. Cawaale wuxuu xanaajiyay qof walba, wuuna tagay.

Kadib Basra waxay keentay shaah iyo bun. Bunka Soomaaliga ah aad buu u fiican yahay. "Kee baad rabtaa, shaah mise bun?" ayay tidhi Basra. Cabdirisaaq ayaa u tarjumay Astrid.

"Kee baa ka macaan?" ayay weydiisay Astrid.

"Bunka ayaa ka macaan," ayuu yidhi Cabdirisaaq. Astrid bun bay cabtay. "Bunkani waa heersare!" ayay tidhi.

Kadib, Astrid waxay Basra u sheegtay hadal ku saabsan maalinteeda. Cabdirisaaq ayaa Basra u tarjumay. Basra way qososhay. "Mahadsanid, Astrid. Mahadsanid, turjubaankayga xariifka ah," ayay tidhi.

Su'aalo:
Cabdirisaaq muxuu ka shaqeeyaa?
Cabdirisaaq waa turjubaan.
Turjunka Cabdirisaaq sidee buu yahay?
Turjunka Cabdirisaaq waa heersare.
Cawaale muxuu Basra ku yidhi?
Cawaale wuxuu yidhi: "Cuntadaadu waa heersare!"
Maxaa Cabdirisaaq xanaajiyay?
Cawaale ayaa Cabdirisaaq xanaajiyay, waayo waa nin jeesjees ah.
Basra maxay Astrid weydiisay?
Basra waxay tidhi: "Kee baad rabtaa, shaah mise bun?"
Cabdirisaaq ma nin xariif ah baa?
Haa, Cabdirisaaq waa nin xariif ah.

lessons.title: Qolka Saleebaan
lessons.summary: In Mogadishu, the friends Daa'uud and Ayni count the coins they have saved for a party at the end of their studies; the hall owner Saleebaan has no room in March, so they book the first Tuesday in April, he tells them the hall is insured, that he keeps control of it and bans alcohol and fireworks, ends the party at eleven, and they thank him warmly.
lessons.text:
Daa'uud iyo Ayni waa laba saaxiib oo wax ka barta jaamacad ku taal Muqdisho. Sannadkan way dhammaynayaan jaamacadda. Waxay rabaan inay saaxiibbadood u sameeyaan kulan.

Sannad oo dhan, Daa'uud iyo Ayni waxay beesad ku dhigayeen kiish yar. Maalin walba beesad yar. Hadda kiishada beesad badan baa ku jirta. Way tiriyeen beesadda. "Beesad badan baynu haysannaa," ayay tidhi Ayni. "Lacagtan qol weyn baynu ku heli karnaa."

Waxay u tageen nin la yidhaahdo Saleebaan. Saleebaan wuxuu leeyahay qol weyn oo kulanka loo sameeyo. "Kulankeenna bisha maarso ayaan rabnaa," ayuu yidhi Daa'uud.

"Maarso qolku waa buuxaa," ayuu yidhi Saleebaan. "Maarso oo dhan waxaa qolka ku jira kulanka guurka. Abriil qolku waa madhan yahay."

"Haye, abriil," ayay tidhi Ayni. "Talaadada kowaad ee abriil." Saleebaan wuxuu qoray: talaado, abriil.

"Dhagaysta," ayuu yidhi Saleebaan. "Qolkan waan caymiyay. Haddii wax jabaan, lacag baan helayaa, waayo qolka waan caymiyay. Laakiin kontaroolka qolka aniga ayaa haya. Kontaroolka albaabka iyo nalalka aniga ayaa haya."

"Khamriga iyo baaruudda waan mamnuuci doonaa," ayuu yidhi. "Mamnuucidaas waa adag tahay. Saacadda kow iyo toban, kulanka waan bakhtiiyaa."

Talaadadii abriil, saaxiibbadood oo dhan way yimaadeen. Way cuneen, hees bay qaadeen, way qosleen. Qofna khamri ma keenin, baaruudna lama keenin. Saacadda kow iyo toban, Saleebaan wuu bakhtiiyay kulanka. "Kulanka waan bakhtiiyay, waayo saacaddii way timid," ayuu yidhi.

Daa'uud iyo Ayni waxay u tageen Saleebaan. "Gallad weyn ayaan kuu hayna," ayay tidhi Ayni. "Qolkaagu aad buu u fiican yahay." Saleebaan wuu qoslay. "Galladdiinna waan ku faraxsanahay," ayuu yidhi.

Su'aalo:
Daa'uud iyo Ayni maxay ku dhigayeen kiishada?
Waxay kiishada ku dhigayeen beesad.
Kontaroolka qolka yaa haya?
Kontaroolka qolka Saleebaan ayaa haya.
Kulanku goorma buu ahaa?
Kulanku wuxuu ahaa talaadada kowaad ee abriil.
Yaa qolka caymiyay?
Saleebaan ayaa qolka caymiyay.
Saleebaan muxuu mamnuuci doonaa?
Saleebaan wuxuu mamnuuci doonaa khamriga iyo baaruudda.
Ayni maxay Saleebaan u sheegtay?
Ayni waxay tidhi: "Gallad weyn ayaan kuu hayna."

lessons.title: Warqad ka timid London
lessons.summary: A birthday letter: Sureer, who lives in London, writes to her childhood friend Muhubo in Burco on her fortieth birthday and remembers watering the camels, the dust, the lice that Muhubo's grandmother got rid of, a brother's bow, a hurt knee, teenage spots, and the grandmother's warning never to curse anyone.
lessons.text:
Muhubo, saaxiibtay,

Maanta waxaad noqonaysaa afartan jir. Warqaddan waxaan kaaga soo qorayaa London. Waxaan rabaa inaan kuu sheego waxyaabihii aynu wada samayn jirnay markii aynu carruurta ahayn.

Labadeennuba waxaynu ku noolayn miyiga, meel u dhow Burco. Reerkayga iyo reerkaagu waa Iidoor. Ayeeyadaa waxay odhan jirtay: "Iidoor iyo Iidoor waa walaalo."

Subax walba waxaynu tagi jirnay ceelka. Waraabinta geela waxay ahayd shaqadeenna. Waraabinta geela way adkayd, laakiin waan jeclayn. Ceelka meel u dhow bus badan ayaa jiray. Buska ayaa gali jiray timaheenna. Habeenkii buska ayaynu timaha ka dhaqi jirnay.

Timaheenna cinjir ayaa ku jiri jiray. Cinjirku wuxuu ahaa mid badan. Ayeeyadaa ayaa cinjirka baabin jirtay. Waxay cinjirka ku baabin jirtay saliid. "Cinjirka waan baabiyey," ayay odhan jirtay.

Walaalkaa wuxuu geed ka sameeyay qaanso. Qaansadiisa aad buu u jeclaa. Maalin, waxaan rabay inaan qaansada iskudayo. Geed baan fuulay, kadibna waan ka dhacay. Jilbaha ayaan ku dhacay. Jilbaha xanuun badan baa galay. Adiga ayaa i caawisay. Jilbaha biyo ayaad iiga dhaqday.

Markii aynu afar iyo toban jir ahayn, wajigeenna finan ayaa ka soo baxay. Finanka ma jeclayn. Waxaynu isku eegi jirnay muraayadda. "Finankani ma tagi doonaan," ayaad odhan jirtay. Laakiin finanku way tageen.

Ayeeyadaa waxay had iyo jeer odhan jirtay: "Habaar ha odhanina. Habaarku waa xun yahay." Ilaa maanta, habaar ma aan odhan.

Muhubo, mahadsanid. Diseembarka dambe waxaan iman doonaa Burco. Waxaynu wada cuni doonnaa hilib iyo bariis, sheekooyin badanna waynu wada sheegi doonnaa.

Saaxiibtaa,
Sureer

Su'aalo:
Sureer xaggee bay warqadda ka soo qortay?
Sureer warqadda waxay ka soo qortay London.
Sureer iyo Muhubo shaqadoodu maxay ahayd?
Shaqadoodu waxay ahayd waraabinta geela.
Yaa cinjirka baabin jirtay?
Ayeeyada Muhubo ayaa cinjirka baabin jirtay.
Walaalka Muhubo muxuu sameeyay?
Walaalka Muhubo wuxuu sameeyay qaanso.
Sureer maxay ku dhacday markay geedka ka dhacday?
Sureer waxay ku dhacday jilbaha.
Ayeeyadu maxay odhan jirtay?
Ayeeyadu waxay odhan jirtay: "Habaar ha odhanina."
